verification.migrations: Deterministic schema v1 through v6 migration tests passed

leaseLifecycle.activeAttempt: A held lease remains charged after its nominal expiry time while its attempt stage is not done.
leaseLifecycle.settledAttempt: Settlement replaces the hold with either a priced settled amount or the unknown-usage pending hold and starts a new window from settlement.
leaseLifecycle.expiryAudit: Once the attempt is done and the settlement window ends, the lease transitions to expired exactly once. Amount, priced, expiry, and expiredAt are retained.
leaseLifecycle.activeBudgetQuery: Released leases and expired completed leases stop consuming budget. Active leases continue consuming budget.
leaseLifecycle.idempotency: Repeated budget queries and explicit expiration passes do not duplicate budget_lease_expired events.

cli.status: budget status performs the idempotent expiration audit before reporting policy usage
cli.audit: budget audit --limit <n> returns current policy status and recent expired leases with taskId, attemptId, amount, priced, expiresAt, and expiredAt
cli.invalidLimit: Rejected when it is not a positive integer
